description: Text a client (comms scope). Pass dry_run=true to preview without sending. US/Canada numbers only unless the account has other countries switched on, and each account has a daily and monthly text limit (lower in its first month) — a 429 with code sms_daily_cap / sms_monthly_cap / sms_international means nothing was sent. Texts go out from the account's OWN texting number: a 409 sms_no_number means it has none yet — call setup_texting_number first.

body.description: The message or email body (HTML or text, per the tool).

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

dry_run.description: If true, preview the result without sending or saving anything.

to.description: The recipient — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

name: send_text
title: Send Text
